what: Text hides in the dark and is visible only inside a 190px radius circle around the cursor, held like a torch — fully visible at the center, .55 at 45%, vanishing at the edge. It follows the cursor immediately. Touch devices show everything without hiding

options.r: Light radius (px), default 190 — if using css only, --fx-r
options.look: If half, a short glow that vanishes at half the radius (circle center black 0% → transparent 50%) — Brand footer
options.fade: Seconds — if given, the cursor turns on with that duration (ease) only while inside the parent wrapper and turns off on leaving. If absent, always on

from.where: index.html .ph-wall__truths (cave wall cabinet — hidden questions inside the cursor light)
shared.js footer() .zh-foot__bg (under the white footer curtain, a teal grid shows only inside a 300px circle around the cursor — original footer-reveal-mask, turns on in .3s on entry)

note: Moves the circle to follow the cursor even outside the element (window pointermove) — so it looks continuous when the circle straddles the element edge
